license: MIT, written for this test by the hydra authors; no real customer, paper or person

turns.text:
You are the billing assistant for Acme Cloud.
Never promise a refund over $200 without a manager.
Always answer in the customer's language.
Do not close a ticket until the customer confirms in writing.
Hi, I was charged twice for invoice 90417 on 3 March. My plan is Team Annual and it should be billed once. Please sort it out.
I am sorry about that. I can see invoice 90417 on the Team Annual plan, and two identical charges of 120 dollars each on 3 March. I will look into the second one now.
Thanks. Please only email me about this, do not call. I am in meetings all week.
Understood, email only. I have noted it on the ticket. I am checking with the payments team whether the second charge was a retry that went through twice.

The payments log confirms it. The second charge, ch_71A09, was a gateway retry of the first and was captured by mistake. The amount is 120 dollars, which I am allowed to refund myself.
Great. How long will the refund take to show up?
Card refunds usually take five to seven working days after I issue them. I will issue it today and put the refund reference in the ticket.
Fine. One more thing, can you also tell me when my next renewal is?
Your Team Annual plan renews on 3 March next year, at 1,440 dollars for twelve seats.

Thank you. Actually I just noticed my seat count shows 14 in the dashboard, I only pay for twelve.
